title: Trim Meta-Agent spec to focus on Meta-Agent
description: Update the Meta-Agent spec so it only references the Meta-Agent itself. Remove or rewrite sections that mention other agents, ensure guidance is scoped to the Meta-Agent responsibilities, and clarify any language that implies multi-agent coordination.

title: Meta-agent learnings tracking
description: Add functionality for the meta agent to organize meta learnings, recurring tasks, failures/resolutions, and other related items as markdown documents under a new learnings/ directory.

title: Proposal agent OpenSpec
description: Draft an OpenSpec addition for a Proposal-specialist agent that owns the OpenSpec flow, researches best practices (exa, etc.), and only writes under openspec/.
notes: Progress: openspec/changes/add-proposal-agent now includes proposal, tasks, design, and spec deltas. Validation command: 'openspec validate add-proposal-agent --strict' → output 'Change 'add-proposal-agent' is valid'. Next step is stakeholder review and sign-off.

title: Provide QA-accessible wrappers for slack-notify and knowledge-graph
description: QA for beads agents-cjk / change portable-config-bundle could not run slack-notify --help (command missing) or make knowledge-graph entries because .opencode/skill/knowledge-graph only exposes instructions. Need CLI wrappers or documented alternative workflows so QA/Release can send comms+KG logs without Orchestrator assist.

title: Expand portable-config-bundle spec for multi-project adoption
description: Document how the portable-config-bundle change applies when integrating into existing monorepos and new greenfield services, covering shared vs per-project configs and service-specific agent instructions.

title: Meta-agent provider unavailable
description:
Invoking the meta-agent via task (subagent_type: meta-agent) fails with ProviderModelNotFoundError. This blocks the workflow requirement to engage the Meta-Agent for instrumentation gaps (see agents-pzm / agents-7ok session).

Repro: call the meta-agent through the task tool.
Expected: meta-agent responds with improvement guidance.

title: Blueprint scaffolding command OpenSpec
description: Capture change proposal for a one-shot command (likely npx) that applies this repo's agentic blueprint to any new repo. Must include link back to the eventual OpenSpec change once it exists.
notes: Progress: openspec/changes/add-blueprint-scaffold-command now includes proposal, tasks, design, and spec deltas. Validation command: 'openspec validate add-blueprint-scaffold-command --strict' → output 'Change 'add-blueprint-scaffold-command' is valid'. Next step is stakeholder review before implementation.

title: Plan bespoke OpenCode setup
description: Draft AGENT instructions for beads+OpenSpec collaboration, then create an OpenSpec proposal for the custom OpenCode configuration/workflow.
